sources.title: Cathay Group December 2025 traffic figures
sources.supports: Aggregate HK Express passenger counts and load factors; no matching membership conversion or segment-share table.

limitations: The reviewed official reports do not publish this 14-segment customer distribution; all numerical segment weights and budget distributions remain test assumptions.
All sampled travellers are already valid members; no membership purchase, renewal, taxes, fuel fees or airline costs enter this experiment.
Each sampled member decides about one personal ticket. Family/group context is retained, but companions' purchases are outside this experiment.
Poststratified rates and expected revenue are estimates. Accepted ticket counts and cash revenue remain integer transactions in the cleared panel.
An LLM persona is not an independent observed HK Express customer; repeated choices do not create additional people.

thompson_vs_greedy.comparison: Matched search budgets and common synthetic preference draws; independent analytic holdout scoring.

limitations: All response functions, customer budgets, segment shares and preferences are declared synthetic assumptions, not measured HK Express demand.
The logistic family tests a near-model demand family; the discontinuous reference-price family is a deliberate misspecification check.
Only member base-ticket revenue is optimized and scored. Normal-ticket displacement, membership fees, annual usage and operating costs are outside this benchmark.
Search uses a stratified panel and clustered repeated preferences. Evaluation uses an independent finite support for the weighted iid target cohort; it is not a realized airline market.

Both methods receive the same round/panel budget; repeated identical person-price observations are deduplicated before fitting and are not additional information. Unique observation counts can differ between methods.
Capacity expectation is E[min(Q,K)] with K Binomial(N,q_weighted). Target cohort composition is random, unlike the fixed stratified search panel.
The oracle is an evaluation-only numerical reference using independent synthetic truth; no holdout responses, optimum or scores enter either search.
This finite benchmark does not prove global convergence or that Thompson Sampling outperforms greedy selection in every scenario.
